name: Tobimune
description: (Tag:fire)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:movement)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:weapon)One of the Seven Enchanted Blades, Tobimune amplifies the user's energy to power 3 abilities but is very difficult to master; a true master can unlock more. It creates and controls Black Feathers for wings and sensory awareness: Crow swaps you or your weapon with any feather in range; Owl creates massive sky eyes that massively expand sensory range; Suzaku expends energy for flames that heal you and damage enemies.
